# Check: iPad keyboard width (A04-crumb624)

1. Build and install the iOS app on an iPad (or iPad simulator): `scripts/build-ios.sh`.
2. Open any text field with the Tatakikun keyboard in portrait: the keyboard (candidate bar and keys) is about 90% of the screen width, centered, with an equal gap on each side.
3. Rotate to landscape: still about 90% of the (now wider) width, centered.
4. On an iPhone the keyboard still fills the full width.
